title: Mini SOS Daily Hypochlorous Acid Spray for Breakouts & Redness

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, oilFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Redness✓ Alcohol Free✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Acne/Blemishes✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ allure 2026 Best of Beauty Award Winner

What it is: A clinically proven, derm-approved hypochlorous acid spray that keeps post-gym breakouts at bay, reduces redness, and soothes stressed skin.


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Hypochlorous Acid: Naturally produced by the body's immune system as a first line of defense to fight the appearance of redness, it soothes, nourishes, and cares for sensitive or stressed skin—leaving it looking clear, soft, and healthy.

- Water and Sodium Chloride: This non-drying solution is formulated to mimic the makeup of our bodies—it’s the optimal delivery solution for hypochlorous acid since it’s found naturally in white blood cells.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use morning and evening.
-For best results, spray on dry, freshly- cleansed skin.
-Let dry down completely before applying moisturizer.
-Use for blemishes, sunburns, rashes, eczema, post-workout, and post-procedure.

Recycling Instructions:
-New packaging is made from 100 percent post-consumer resin (recycled plastic). Bottle is also fully recyclable, just remove the cap.
Ingredients+
-Hypochlorous Acid: Naturally produced by the body's immune system, it's anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties help defend your skin from harmful bacteria, reduce redness, and soothe irritation.
-Water and Sodium Chloride: Act as the optimal delivery solution for hypochlorous acid.

Water, Sodium Chloride, Hypochlorous Acid.



The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
